en.headline: Sushiro opens a Sham Shui Po branch at Dragon Centre
en.dek: The conveyor-belt chain’s new shop on the second floor of Dragon Centre starts service on Monday, the company said.
body: Japanese conveyor-belt chain Sushiro is opening a Sham Shui Po branch on Monday at Dragon Centre, according to the company.

The shop is at unit 201 on the second floor of Dragon Centre, 37K Yen Chow Street. The company said service hours are 11:30am to 9pm, with last orders at 8:30pm, and that takeaway collection will also be offered. Seating tickets were due to be handed out from 9:30am, with an opening ceremony at 11:15am.

On the opening day the company said a limited number of plates, including eggplant miso and fatty tuna, would be sold at a set price of HK$12, for dine-in only. Further opening-week items and gifts were described as limited to this branch and subject to stock.
Dragon Centre already houses several Japanese restaurant chains. The new shop is the chain’s latest Hong Kong location; the company did not announce a change to hours at its other branches.

zh.headline: 壽司郎深水埗西九龍中心分店周一開業
zh.dek: 迴轉壽司連鎖店表示，新店位於西九龍中心二樓，星期一開始營業。
body: 日式迴轉壽司連鎖店壽司郎星期一在深水埗西九龍中心開設新店，公司表示當日開始營業。
新店地址為欽州街37K號西九龍中心2樓201號舖。公司指營業時間為上午11時30分至晚上9時，最後下單時間為晚上8時30分，並設外賣自取。入座籌由上午9時30分開始派發，開幕儀式則訂於上午11時15分。
公司表示，開幕當日部分壽司包括茄子田樂味噌及吞拿魚腩，限量以每碟12元供應，只限堂食。開幕周的限定食品和贈品亦只在這間分店提供，送完即止。
西九龍中心已有多間日式連鎖餐廳。公司未有宣布其他分店的營業時間會因新店開業而調整。
